Consider the region $R$ shown above. Let the function $f(x,y)$ be defined as

$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}0, & (x,y)\in S, \\ \frac{x}{1+{y}^{2}}, & (x,y)\in T, \\ \frac{y}{1+{x}^{2}}, & (x,y)\in U.\end{aligned}
$$

Then,

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A=
$$
worked_solution:
First, notice that the domain $R$ can be represented as a union of three sub-domains, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}R & =S\cup T\cup U.\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{S}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{T}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{U}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{S}0\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{T}\frac{x}{1+{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{U}\frac{y}{1+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{T}\frac{x}{1+{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{U}\frac{y}{1+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$
